Fig. 1. Saliency map comparison between robust and nonrobust organ-classification models for a right-kidney CT slice (top) and a slightly perturbed adversarial version (bottom). The robust model’s attributions remain stable between the original and adversarial images and concentrate on kidneyrelevant anatomy, whereas the nonrobust model’s attributions change markedly under perturbation and appear almost noiselike. Overlays are normalized to [0, 1]; brighter colors indicate larger attribution.
